course.name: Building Materials in the Built Environment

provenance.source_document: SRMIST B.Tech Regulation 2021 Curriculum & Syllabus - 21CEB101T Building Materials in the Built Environment
provenance.notes: Authoritative 5-unit syllabus covering Traditional Materials (Stones, Bricks, Cement, Steel, Timber), Finishing and Insulating Materials (Paints, Glass, Plastics, DPC), Building Construction and Safety (Masonry, Cavity Walls, Stairs, Fire & Termite Protection), Alternative & Modern Materials (Ferrocement, Fly Ash, Gypsum, Agro Waste), and Green Buildings & Ventilation (GRIHA, Air Quality, Natural Ventilation).
